The flow for Figure 35 is relatively simple, the key aspect to note here is that the 
SpacedRepetitionHandler generates a list of LessonModels that will be displayed. 
Looking at Table 17, you can see that the partition key is the S3url, this can 
then be used to get the lesson name from the metadata file as discussed in 4.6. 
You will notice that the for loop only looks at items that are “ready”, a lesson is 
considered ready when the current time is at least 23 hours before the lesson is 
due.
